title: Lung nodule volumetry: segmentation algorithms within the same software package cannot be used interchangeably
inspection_scope: Indexed primary abstract and selected full-text sections; direct PMC browser check
locator: Abstract; Methods; Discussion (indexed; also September 14 register)
design: Two readers; three commercial algorithms; baseline nodules and follow-ups.
established_finding: Alternative segmentation could improve contour quality while degrading volume agreement.
limitation: Inter-observer/algorithm comparison; neither Dice-based neural updating nor our reference-change MAE.
project_implication: The generic contour-versus-measurement-consistency observation is established.

title: Inter-method Performance Study of Tumor Volumetry Assessment on Computed Tomography Test-retest Data
inspection_scope: Reuse September 14 selected full-text inspection; current indexed metadata; direct PMC browser check
locator: September 14: Introduction, Materials and Methods, Results, Discussion
design: Multiple volumetry algorithms on short-interval CT repeat scans.
established_finding: Quantifies repeatability and between-algorithm reproducibility.
limitation: Zero-change design differs from annotation-referenced biological change; no controlled added-data neural update.
project_implication: An audit needs an incremental decision-relevant finding beyond software dependence.

title: Inter- and intra-software reproducibility of computed tomography lung density measurements
inspection_scope: Primary full-text abstract and selected Methods/Results
design: 50 COPDGene participants; eight tools; standardized acquisitions; repeated processing and QA.
established_finding: Low systematic bias and deterministic within-tool repeat processing; between-tool variability remains.
limitation: Whole-lung/density measurements differ from tumour volumes; abstract TLV unit conflicts with Table II, so no numerical TLV bias reused.
project_implication: Version effects have context-dependent magnitude; same-image checks do not replace scan-rescan testing.

title: Freesurfer Software Update Significantly Impacts Striatal Volumes in the Huntington's Disease Young Adult Study and Will Influence HD-ISS Staging
inspection_scope: Current publisher-indexed title/abstract; reuse September 14 institutional Discussion inspection
design: FreeSurfer 6 versus 7; striatal measurements and staging-related volume thresholds.
established_finding: Version changes affect volumes relevant to an established staging system.
limitation: Brain MRI; specific staging framework; not evidence of tumour response errors in our data.
project_implication: Clinical importance of version changes is not itself a new claim.

title: Positive-Congruent Training: Towards Regression-Free Model Updates
inspection_scope: Official indexed abstract and paper Introduction; direct HTML failed
design: Classification model updates; focal distillation emphasizes previously correct examples.
established_finding: Aggregate improvement and negative prediction flips can coexist; targeted distillation reduces regression.
limitation: Categorical correctness is not continuous paired-volume error; ordinary KD is not the focal method.
project_implication: Do not claim discovery of update regression or a novel generic distillation remedy.

title: Backward Compatibility During Data Updates by Weight Interpolation
inspection_scope: Current official metadata/abstract; September 14 selected PDF methods reused
design: Text-classification data addition; interpolation of old and fine-tuned descendant weights.
established_finding: BCWI reduces negative flips while retaining accuracy gains in its evaluation.
limitation: Cross-domain transfer is unproven; our strengths are multiple secondary comparisons.
project_implication: Our BCWI controls are existing baselines, not a new compatibility algorithm.

title: Measuring and Reducing Model Update Regression in Structured Prediction for NLP
inspection_scope: Official abstract and indexed author-paper Introduction
design: Dependency and conversational semantic parsing; model-update regression and existing remedies.
established_finding: Regression evaluation extends beyond simple classification; proposes backward-congruent reranking.
limitation: Structured NLP outputs differ from CT measurements; cannot infer absence of every continuous-output study.
project_implication: Structured output alone is an insufficient novelty distinction.

title: Incremental Nuclei Segmentation from Histopathological Images via Future-class Awareness and Compatibility-inspired Distillation
inspection_scope: Official indexed metadata and abstract; direct HTML failed
design: Incremental nuclei classes without old-class training examples; two histopathology datasets.
established_finding: Compatibility-inspired distillation already appears in medical segmentation.
limitation: New classes and unavailable old data differ from our fixed-label added-data update.
project_implication: Reject first-medical-segmentation-compatibility language; this is adjacent prior art.

title: Exploiting Longitudinal Context in Clinician-Verified Interactive Lesion Tracking
inspection_scope: Primary v1 selected methods, dataset and conclusion; previous experimental-section inspection reused
design: LongiSeg 2.0: verified prompts and baseline appearance; PanTrack introduced.
established_finding: Longitudinal information and promptability are occupied research contributions.
limitation: Pinned preprint; prospective reader study is future work; paper release statements are not checkpoint verification.
project_implication: Relevant task boundary; no checkpoint is needed for our within-update diagnosis.

title: LesionLocator: Zero-Shot Universal Tumor Segmentation and Tracking in 3D Whole-Body Imaging
inspection_scope: Official proceedings abstract and indexed paper introduction; earlier selected preprint inspection retained
design: Promptable segmentation and longitudinal tracking with broad pretraining and synthetic pairs.
established_finding: A modern integrated tracking/segmentation system already exists.
limitation: Different localization and training resources; cross-paper Dice values are not fair comparisons.
project_implication: Do not market our crop-based study as a universal tracking benchmark.

title: Metrics reloaded: recommendations for image analysis validation
inspection_scope: Primary indexed framework, discussion and recommendations
locator: Metrics Reloaded framework; problem fingerprints; Extended Data Table 1
design: Multistage Delphi and community process for problem-aware evaluation.
established_finding: Metric selection should follow the scientific task and use complementary measures.
limitation: Consensus framework, not an empirical demonstration of our model-update effect.
project_implication: Retain volume-change endpoints and contours; technical accuracy does not establish clinical utility.

title: Understanding metric-related pitfalls in image analysis validation
inspection_scope: Published-version abstract and indexed taxonomy; not a complete supplement reading
design: Multidisciplinary Delphi process collecting metric-selection/application pitfalls.
established_finding: Inappropriate metrics and aggregation can misrepresent image-analysis progress.
limitation: Companion to P11 with overlapping contributors; not independent experimental corroboration.
project_implication: Generic Dice mismatch is established; distinguish patient aggregation, lesion size and target task.

title: Random effects during training: Implications for deep learning-based medical image segmentation
inspection_scope: Publisher-indexed and institutional abstract/metadata; full methods not inspected; publisher direct 403
design: nnU-Net with 50 seeds on three 3D segmentation tasks; hold-out and cross-validation comparisons.
established_finding: Training randomness can produce significant differences between instances of the same learning algorithm.
limitation: Different tasks and Dice endpoint; 50 runs is a study design, not a universal required minimum.
project_implication: Our patient-bootstrap intervals cannot establish repeatability over future training runs.

title: Accounting for Variance in Machine Learning Benchmarks
inspection_scope: Official paper selected abstract, introduction and sections 5-6; search-indexed sections 1-2
locator: Abstract; section 6 Comparing models instead of procedures
design: Benchmarks with several sources of pipeline variation; repeated-performance estimation.
established_finding: Fixed-model evaluation differs from learning-procedure evaluation.
limitation: Their task-specific thresholds and run-count examples cannot become our clinical margin or fixed requirement.
project_implication: Match the uncertainty target to the claim; more test patients do not sample new training runs.

title: nnU-Net Revisited: A Call for Rigorous Validation in 3D Medical Image Segmentation
inspection_scope: Official abstract, metadata and selected indexed conclusion; not all experiments read
design: Reassesses CNN, Transformer and Mamba comparisons with stronger configuration/budget controls.
established_finding: Configured U-Nets remain strong; weak baselines distort architectural comparisons.
limitation: Does not validate our small custom U-Net or imply it is state of the art.
project_implication: An old architecture is acceptable for a controlled question; broader claims need a credible strong baseline.

citation: Obuchowski et al., Algorithm Comparison Working Group (2015)
title: Quantitative Imaging Biomarkers: A Review of Statistical Methods for Computer Algorithm Comparisons
venue: Statistical Methods in Medical Research 24:68-106; online 2014
inspection_scope: Primary indexed abstract and selected design/equivalence sections; earlier sections reused
design: Framework distinguishing truth, reference-standard and agreement designs.
established_finding: Reference error, repeatability, agreement and equivalence answer different questions.
limitation: Methodological source; not an empirical result for the current CT cohort.
project_implication: No clinical-equivalence claim from a zero-crossing CI or the operational 5 mL precision target.

title: Within-subject template estimation for unbiased longitudinal image analysis
inspection_scope: Primary abstract and indexed selected methods; official software explanatory documentation
locator: Abstract; Methods Overview and Within-subject template
design: Symmetric longitudinal brain MRI processing with within-person templates.
established_finding: Temporal processing can reduce variability while needing safeguards against bias and over-regularization.
limitation: Not a segmentation-version intervention; temporal regularity is not automatically accuracy.
project_implication: Avoid a preserve-the-old-volume objective that suppresses true change.

title: Real-world clinical impact of implementing and updating a deep learning-based automatic contouring system in rectal cancer radiotherapy
venue: Journal of Applied Clinical Medical Physics 27:e70768
inspection_scope: Current primary abstract Methods/Results; full article blocked and not inspected
design: 150 retrospective cases in three cohorts; six oncologists on 21 additional cases.
established_finding: An update improved contouring and workflow outcomes in this evaluation.
limitation: Different task; nonrandomized clinical cohorts; abstract does not establish every analysis present or absent.
project_implication: Do not imply updates generally harm care; clinical benefit requires workflow evidence we lack.

title: A longitudinal whole-body CT dataset with manually annotated tumor lesions
inspection_scope: Primary indexed abstract, Data Records and Technical Validation; previous Methods reused
design: Paired melanoma CT with reference masks, centres and lesion correspondences.
established_finding: Provides annotated longitudinal measurement data and explicit temporal lesion identities.
limitation: Release-specific intake determines actual eligibility; labels are references, not perfect biological truth.
project_implication: Use existing gated data; reference-centroid localization must be disclosed.

title: Annotated test-retest dataset of lung cancer CT scan images reconstructed at multiple imaging parameters
inspection_scope: Primary metadata and abstract; earlier dataset description reused
design: 32 NSCLC patients, same-day repeat scans and six reconstruction settings.
established_finding: A suitable resource for investigating acquisition-related measurement repeatability.
limitation: Different disease and design; adds acquisition variation and requires new payload/access checks.
project_implication: Reserve for a distinct scan-rescan question; not needed for same-image version-offset diagnosis.

title: Model ChangeLists: Characterizing Updates to ML Models
inspection_scope: Official PDF abstract and Introduction; indexed task description
design: Six real-world ML API updates; slice-level changes and user study.
established_finding: Global performance gains can conceal degradation on coherent data subsets.
limitation: Not CT or paired continuous measurements; author webpage omits an author present in the PDF.
project_implication: Do not present subgroup update audits as new; inspect all patients without searching for favorable slices.

title: Unstable Prompts, Unreliable Segmentations: A Challenge for Longitudinal Lesion Analysis
inspection_scope: Published chapter abstract/metadata and selected author-preprint Methods; version difference not exhaustively compared
design: ULS23 longitudinal CT evaluation with controlled crop displacement.
established_finding: Localization errors can degrade segmentation and lesion correspondence.
limitation: Prompt perturbation is a different intervention from changing weights at fixed prompts.
project_implication: Strongest localization caveat; a generic single-timepoint-fails-longitudinally claim is occupied.

title: Liver lesion changes analysis in longitudinal CECT scans by simultaneous deep learning voxel classification with SimU-Net
inspection_scope: Primary indexed abstract/metadata only
design: Registered prior/current CT; simultaneous segmentation, lesion matching and change classification.
established_finding: Paired lesion-change analysis and reusing prior segmentations are already established.
limitation: Full methods not inspected; cannot certify split details or absence of version comparisons.
project_implication: A generic temporal U-Net or prior-mask extension does not establish a novel next paper.
